title: Rank of the orthogonal complement of a line
statement:
Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional real inner product space, and let $u \in V$ be a unit vector, so that $\norm{u} = 1$. Then the orthogonal complement of the line $\mathrm{span}_{\bbr}\{u\}$ has dimension one less than that of $V$:
\[
\dim_{\bbr}\bigl(\mathrm{span}_{\bbr}\{u\}\bigr)^{\perp} = \dim_{\bbr} V - 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: V is a finite-dimensional real inner product space
u is a vector of V with norm 1
replaced:
For a unit vector $u$ in a finite-dimensional real inner product space $V$,
$\dim_{\mathbb{R}} (\mathrm{span}_{\mathbb{R}}\{u\})^{\perp} = \dim_{\mathbb{R}} V - 1$.
